name: Sundrel Post 28 EGEO
description: Key Features High-Precision Benthic-Range Pressure Calibrator: Delivers an accuracy class of 0.75%, ensuring reliable and precise pressure measurements in underwater environments. Wide Operating Temperature Range: Functions effectively from -40°C, making it suitable for extreme cold-water and deep-sea applications. Fast Sampling Rate: Captures data at 1316.6 Hz, supporting real-time monitoring and rapid response needs in dynamic conditions. Extended Calibration Interval: Requires calibration only every 25 months, reducing maintenance frequency and operational downtime. Stable Mounting Tripod: Includes a secure tripod mount for easy installation and stability during measurements, even in challenging underwater settings. Six-Axis Data Reference: Provides comprehensive measurements across six axes, aligning with industry standards for benthic and subsea pressure calibrators. Main Benefits Accurate Underwater Pressure Measurement: Ideal for researchers and engineers needing dependable data in marine, oceanographic, or benthic studies. Durable and Reliable in Harsh Conditions: Engineered to withstand low temperatures and high-pressure environments, ensuring consistent performance over time. Reduced Maintenance Costs: The long calibration interval minimizes service interruptions and lowers total cost of ownership. Easy Setup and Use: The included tripod and standardized six-axis reference simplify deployment and integration into existing measurement systems. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Marine Research: Enables precise monitoring of underwater pressure changes for oceanography, environmental studies, and habitat mapping. Industrial Applications: Supports subsea engineering projects, offshore oil and gas operations, and underwater construction requiring accurate pressure calibration. Long-Term Monitoring: Suited for permanent or semi-permanent installations where infrequent calibration and high data fidelity are essential. Data-Driven Decision Making: Facilitates high-frequency data collection, supporting detailed analysis and informed operational adjustments in real time. Answers to Common Questions Durability: Built for extended use in demanding underwater environments, including extreme cold. Ease of Use: The tripod and standardized configuration ensure straightforward installation and compatibility with common data acquisition systems. Value: The long calibration interval and robust design help reduce ongoing maintenance and replacement costs. description_html:
Key Features

  • High-Precision Benthic-Range Pressure Calibrator: Delivers an accuracy class of 0.75%, ensuring reliable and precise pressure measurements in underwater environments.
  • Wide Operating Temperature Range: Functions effectively from -40°C, making it suitable for extreme cold-water and deep-sea applications.
  • Fast Sampling Rate: Captures data at 1316.6 Hz, supporting real-time monitoring and rapid response needs in dynamic conditions.
  • Extended Calibration Interval: Requires calibration only every 25 months, reducing maintenance frequency and operational downtime.
  • Stable Mounting Tripod: Includes a secure tripod mount for easy installation and stability during measurements, even in challenging underwater settings.
  • Six-Axis Data Reference: Provides comprehensive measurements across six axes, aligning with industry standards for benthic and subsea pressure calibrators.

Main Benefits

  • Accurate Underwater Pressure Measurement: Ideal for researchers and engineers needing dependable data in marine, oceanographic, or benthic studies.
  • Durable and Reliable in Harsh Conditions: Engineered to withstand low temperatures and high-pressure environments, ensuring consistent performance over time.
  • Reduced Maintenance Costs: The long calibration interval minimizes service interruptions and lowers total cost of ownership.
  • Easy Setup and Use: The included tripod and standardized six-axis reference simplify deployment and integration into existing measurement systems.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Marine Research: Enables precise monitoring of underwater pressure changes for oceanography, environmental studies, and habitat mapping.
  • Industrial Applications: Supports subsea engineering projects, offshore oil and gas operations, and underwater construction requiring accurate pressure calibration.
  • Long-Term Monitoring: Suited for permanent or semi-permanent installations where infrequent calibration and high data fidelity are essential.
  • Data-Driven Decision Making: Facilitates high-frequency data collection, supporting detailed analysis and informed operational adjustments in real time.

Answers to Common Questions

  • Durability: Built for extended use in demanding underwater environments, including extreme cold.
  • Ease of Use: The tripod and standardized configuration ensure straightforward installation and compatibility with common data acquisition systems.
  • Value: The long calibration interval and robust design help reduce ongoing maintenance and replacement costs.

Relevant Keywords:
